evidence.detail: The class is created only by R134 ReportRequestResultsWindow and attached as the exact Find Text dialog's JTextField key listener.

Its keyPressed switch handles Enter, Page Up, Page Down, Up and Down. It searches the main results JTextArea using indexOf/lastIndexOf from the current query and delegates the resulting match span/direction back to the parent window.
The parent window owns the exact 'Find Text' dialog and 'Match results: N/A'/'Match results: current/total' labels, so this listener's role is specifically navigation among text-find matches.

proposals.note: Name follows the exact find-dialog navigation behavior; it is not a general-purpose window key listener.

evidence.detail: The class is instantiated only from R134 ReportRequestResultsReceiver with the receiver, a one-slot ReportRequestResultsWindow holder and the receiver's Queue<String>.
run() lazily constructs ReportRequestResultsWindow when absent, repeatedly polls queued Strings until null and appends every result to the window JTextArea.
This task is the sole exact bridge from the receiver queue into the Report Request Results Swing presentation surface and owns no independent protocol parsing.

proposals.note: Name follows the exact queue-to-window drain behavior.

evidence.detail: The class is created only by R134 ReportRequestResultsWindow and attached as the main results JTextArea key listener.
Its only keyPressed behavior checks key code 70 together with modifier mask 128, then makes the window's exact 'Find Text' JDialog visible; it has no other shortcut or state.
The class holds only its synthetic parent-window reference and touches no receiver, packet or unrelated client state.

proposals.note: Name follows the exact Ctrl+F shortcut behavior that opens the Report Request Results 'Find Text' dialog.
